items.title: COP31 Covered: Green skills, youth voices and a just transition with no teeth?
items.summary: The sixth episode of edie’s daily COP31 Covered podcast is streaming now, featuring an exclusive interview with LinkedIn’s Efrem Bycer on the growing green skills gap.

items.title: ‘Not a favour, an opportunity’: Why youth voices must shape COP31’s implementation era
items.summary: For COP31’s Children, Youth, Education and Skills Day, edie speaks to COP31 Presidency Youth Climate Champion Sally Higgins and The Gaia Initiative team about why young people must be treated as decision-makers rather than a box to tick, and what businesses and governments stand to gain by listening.

items.title: US data centre demand growing ten times faster than grid capacity, research finds
items.summary: US data centre electricity demand has grown almost ten times faster than grid capacity over the past 25 years, with mounting power constraints delaying new developments and accelerating investment in alternative energy sources, according to new research.

items.title: Donors are falling short, but Indigenous communities are delivering
items.summary: As COP31 provides guidance on the world’s climate funds, Indigenous Peoples and local communities must define what counts and how impact is measured, argue Jonathan Jennings, co-chief executive of Health In Harmony and Minnie Degawan, managing director of the FSC Indigenous Foundation.

items.title: ESG台灣快訊》COP31登場，彭啓明盼國際看見台灣｜2050淨零需1兆美元？核能公投再掀討論
items.summary: COP31於11月9日在 安塔利亞登場， 同步啟動戰情中心，預計至20日舉辦10場 ，連線大會現場，掌握氣候談判及國際 政策進展。環境部長彭啓明指出，今年COP31聚焦 、 、韌性及自然為本解方。對照大會提出的十大優先領域與六項全球目標，台灣已啟動 徵收，並將2035年減碳目標提高至36%至40%；國內 比率達34.8%，溫室氣體淨排放量自2021年起連續四年下降，年均減幅逾2%。
